CONFORMS (2026-11-16, kb/Work PB5794 landed): the positional arm of RecordLayout.KeyIndexOfKeyItem now asks SameClassCategoryUsage beside the equal width, so a numeric item of the key's width at the key's positions is refused (COBOL0864 for READ, COBOL0862 for START) at every edition, witnessed by cases/14.9.30-READ/pb5794-read-key-numeric-twin. The alphanumeric same-width twin stays accepted by the implicit-key reading of 12.4.5.12.4 GR4 that kb/Work PB354 chose (a recorded lead, not ruled). Earlier account: PARTIAL (2026-11-16, the 1985 code reads, cause b: wrong the same way at every edition): the mechanism of kb/Work PB5794: PB5794 - the KEY of READ and START on an indexed file is matched to a record key by offset and width only, so an item of another class at the key's position is accepted (every edition). Owner: kb/Work PB5794 (open). Ruled in kb/Work/PB5683/2026-11-15-rulings-code-reads-batch-3.md; the 1985 rows that carry into this rule: 1985-SR-IX.4.5.3-2, 1985-SR-IX.4.7.3-4. Recorded by the registrar from the ruling and its note, the repro not re-run by the registrar. The prose that follows is the stored CONFORMS account, kept as the account of the part that holds. || kb/Work PB358 LANDED 2026-09-09. RULE: 'Data-name-1 or record-key-name-1 shall be specified in the RECORD KEY clause or an ALTERNATE RECORD KEY clause associated with file-name-1.' (cite.py --check 14.9.30.3 OK.)
WHY CONFORMS RATHER THAN PARTIAL: SR11's subject is the READ statement's KEY phrase operand, a claimed facility. Both of its operand classes are now accounted for. data-name-1: KeyedIoBinder.BindRead resolves the operand and calls Model.RecordLayout.KeyIndexOfKeyItem(file, keyPlace.Item); a miss raises COBOL0864 naming SR11. The match is by STORAGE POSITION rather than by name, the stronger reading, cited against 12.4.5.12.4 GR4 - so REDEFINES and duplicate names still resolve, and an operand SHORTER than the key at the same offset is refused (kb/Work PB354 split the shared lookup into KeyIndexOfKeyItem for GR4 / 14.9.41.3 SR6 a) and GenericKeyIndex for SR6 b); BindRead asks the FIRST, which is what SR11 states - there is no generic-key arm in SR11 at all). Witnessed by conformance:cases/14.9.30-READ/pb331_read_lock_brackets: three Format-2 reads name the prime RECORD KEY through the KEY phrase and return the right records (R1=ALPHA, R2=BRAVO) or the invalid key condition (R3=INVALID|23, 9.1.13.5 3) a)).
record-key-name-1: unwritable BY A DOCUMENTED DECISION and, since 2026-09-09, REFUSED BY NAME rather than by a generic parse error. A record-key-name is defined by the SOURCE phrase of the RECORD KEY / ALTERNATE RECORD KEY clause (8.4.6.2.4; the name class is 8.3.2.2.24); Annex A.3 item 40 makes that phrase processor-dependent; docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 2 row 40 declines it; COBOL1954 names the decline at every edition on both clauses, and the five conformance:negative/pb358-* fixtures pin it. The declined half is owned by SR-14.9.41.3-7, which carries DOCUMENTED-NON-SUPPORT. This row was PARTIAL only because that decline was unwitnessed - it is the exact condition the previous note recorded ('PB358 is the note that carries the decline to a NAMED diagnostic').
EDITIONS: the 2023 text carries no edition marker on this clause and Annex E is a 2014-to-2023 delta only. kb/Work PB1099 Q1 (w1095i): the record-key SOURCE phrase is PROVIDED (owner rule R65); the record-key-name-1 arm: READ KEY IS IX-AK / IX-PK IN IXF read by the concatenated key; another file's record-key-name is refused naming SR11. retired-witness: conformance:cases/12.4.5.6-ALTERNATE-RECORD-KEY/pb358-alternate-key-source (the COBOL1954 decline of the SOURCE phrase is retired: kb/Work PB1099 provides it) retired-witness: conformance:cases/12.4.5.6-ALTERNATE-RECORD-KEY/pb358-record-key-source (the COBOL1954 decline of the SOURCE phrase is retired: kb/Work PB1099 provides it) retired-witness: conformance:cases/14.9.30-READ/pb481-read-key-refmod (kb/Work PB5883: the KEY phrase's shape screen refuses the reference-modified operand first (COBOL2024), so the case no longer reaches SR11's identity check; it now witnesses SR-14.9.30.3-12 and SR-8.4.3.3.3-5)
